short_description: How to troubleshoot VPN connectivity issues
text: If you are unable to connect to VPN using GlobalProtect: 1. Restart the GlobalProtect client. 2. Clear cached credentials by navigating to Settings > Sign Out. 3. Reconnect using your network credentials. 4. If the issue persists after a password reset, wait 15 minutes for credential sync to complete. 5. Contact Network Operations if the problem continues.

If Outlook crashes on startup: 1. Open Outlook in Safe Mode (hold Ctrl while clicking the Outlook icon). 2. Disable all add-ins via File > Options > Add-ins. 3. Restart normally. 4. If the issue persists, repair the Office installation via Control Panel > Programs > Microsoft 365 > Change > Repair. 5. As a last resort, delete the Outlook profile and create a new one.

short_description: Requesting access to shared drives and SharePoint sites
text: To request access to a shared drive or SharePoint site: 1. Identify the site owner (usually your team lead or project manager). 2. Submit a request through the IT Service Catalog under 'SharePoint Access Request'. 3. Provide the URL of the SharePoint site and the level of access needed (view, edit, or admin). 4. Approvals typically take 24-48 hours.

short_description: What to do when your employee badge stops working
text: If your badge is not working: 1. Visit the Security desk in the lobby with a valid photo ID. 2. Security will verify your identity and test your badge. 3. If the badge is demagnetized, a replacement will be issued on the spot. 4. Temporary badges are available for immediate access while waiting for a replacement. 5. Badge replacements are free for the first occurrence and $25 subsequently.

short_description: Resolving slow laptop performance after Windows updates
text: If your laptop is slow after a Windows update: 1. Restart your laptop (not just sleep/wake). 2. Check for pending updates in Settings > Windows Update and install any remaining patches. 3. Open Task Manager (Ctrl+Shift+Esc) and check for high CPU/disk usage processes. 4. Run Disk Cleanup to remove temporary update files. 5. If issues persist, contact Desktop Support for a diagnostic session.
